controls.statement: Validate that every category file contains purpose, applicability, universal controls, evidence expectations, and interpretation boundaries.
controls.primary_reason: Required category-file sections are exact structural headings or front-matter fields that can be parsed from the bounded corpus.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every category file contains purpose, applicability, universal controls, evidence expectations, and interpretation-boundary sections.

controls.statement: Measure corpus use, control ambiguity, Not Applicable patterns, exception recurrence, and escaped defects.
controls.primary_reason: With versioned metric definitions, corpus assessments and operational registers supply bounded counts and rates for each named measure.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The corpus program records defined measurements for use, ambiguity, Not Applicable patterns, exception recurrence, and escaped defects.

controls.statement: Every production service has named business and engineering owners.
controls.primary_reason: The production-service inventory is finite, so named business and engineering owner fields can be checked for every service.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every production service has one active business owner and one active engineering owner.

controls.statement: Every third-party integration, dashboard, alert, runbook, scheduled job, and background process has an owner.
controls.primary_reason: Declared integration and operational-asset inventories are finite and support exact owner-cardinality checks.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every third-party integration, dashboard, alert, runbook, scheduled job, and background process in the approved inventories has an active owner.

controls.statement: Escalation paths include primary, secondary, management, security, privacy/legal, and provider contacts.
controls.primary_reason: The escalation contact categories are an exact required field set with resolvable identity or provider references.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every escalation path contains primary, secondary, management, security, privacy or legal, and provider contacts.

controls.statement: Give every risk an owner, likelihood, impact, treatment, evidence, and review date.
controls.primary_reason: Risk identifiers form a finite register whose owner, likelihood, impact, treatment, evidence, and review-date fields can be checked exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every risk in the approved register has owner, likelihood, impact, treatment, evidence reference, and review date.

controls.statement: Record accepted residual risks and the authorized people who accept them.
controls.primary_reason: Accepted residual risks and accepting identities are explicit signed register fields with authorization references.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every accepted residual risk records its value, authenticated accepting people, and their authorization references.

controls.statement: Ensure exceptions expire and compensating controls are tested.
controls.primary_reason: Exception timestamps and compensating-control test records make automatic expiry and test completion directly decidable.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every exception expires automatically at its recorded expiry time.
Every active exception's compensating controls have current successful test evidence.

controls.statement: Map accessibility controls to the selected conformance target.
controls.primary_reason: Once the conformance target is selected, its control or criterion identifiers can be mapped exactly to accessibility controls.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every accessibility control links to one or more criteria in the versioned selected conformance target.

controls.primary_reason: Resolution, trade-off, and approval records are explicit governance artifacts whose presence, identity, and signatures are mechanically decidable.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every registered requirements conflict links to a documented resolution, stated trade-offs, and required authenticated approvals.
